title: Universal code, tools and Elephant settings command governance
purpose: Every piece of code and tool eventually becomes inspectable, safely configurable and independently testable through shared Human↔Machine semantic control, with staged proof gates.

inputs.meaning: Actual source/tool/protocol/configuration and observed authority basis
Versioned semantic proposal from Human or Elephant

outputs.meaning: Authorized effect and independent witness or NOT_RUN

preconditions: Freeze source and owner/agent context epochs
Permission remains held by existing host/owner authority
Independent witness and actual rollback before advancing stage
forbidden: Declare a tool U4 without detecting direct bypass
Self-certify U5 without an external escape and referee

gates.check: No generated intent/visual glyph creates effects
At U4 supported non-interface normal writes fail or produce an authorized exception
Emergency bootstrap and recovery remain independently gated and recorded

outputs.meaning: Coverage gaps enumerated for all code/tool domains

claims: Owner-directed staged governance law; no global enforcement implemented
limitations: This schema is an index and not a host permission engine
